summary: Peace in the Valley is a 1937 gospel song written by Thomas A. Dorsey, originally intended for Mahalia Jackson. It became a hit in 1951 through Red Foley and the Sunshine Boys, reaching number seven on the Country & Western Best Seller chart. The recording was among the first gospel records to sell one million copies, and Foley's version was added to the Library of Congress National Recording Registry in 2006.
